The generation prompt requires a description of each line in the plot ("описание на всяка линия в графиката"). The generated text only provides details for lines N=1 and N=10, and briefly mentions N=4 and N=5, but omits descriptions for lines N=2, N=3, N=6, N=7, N=8, and N=9.
